tools.name: alethe_delegate
tools.description: Hand independent units of work to worker agents that Alethe runs for you. Returns job ids immediately; the workers run in parallel. Delegate any unit that would make you read more than 5 files or that you estimate at over 2 minutes of your own work, and send every qualifying unit in ONE call so they run at the same time. Each task must be self contained.

tools.name: alethe_check
tools.description: Collect what workers reported. With wait set it blocks until they settle. Process every delivery it returns before calling it again.

tools.name: alethe_status
tools.description: Snapshot of every worker without blocking: status, elapsed time, current plan and token usage.

tools.name: alethe_steer
tools.description: Correct a worker while its turn is still running, without killing it or losing its context. Use this instead of cancelling when the worker is heading the wrong way.

tools.name: alethe_send
tools.description: Give a settled worker more work on its existing thread, keeping everything it already learned.

tools.name: alethe_release
tools.description: Let go of settled workers you have no more work for. Account for every worker you started: either send it more work or release it.

tools.name: alethe_diff
tools.description: Read the unified diff a worker has produced so far.
